product_metadata.title: Sterilite 27 Gallon Large Stackable Rugged Industrial Storage Tote Container w/Red Latching Clip Lid for Garage, Attic, or Worksite, Black (8 Pack)
features: Pack of 8 durable storage totes ideal for organizing tools, camping equipment, job-site materials, and more; Capacity: 27 gallons
Rugged, industrial totes offer consumers peace of mind that their stored items will be protected
Features deep recessed lids ideal for secure stacking to provide a space-saving storage solution
Robust latches secure lid to base to provide a tight, drip-protected environment for your items; Black tote design with red latches to easily identify where to open totes
Keyhole design in the lid provides options for tie-downs and textured finish provides a non-slip grip
description: Designed for more active and heavy-duty storage needs, the 8-Pack of Sterilite Industrial Totes are durable and offer 27 gallons of storage space each, providing you with loads of room for organizing and sorting your items. These totes have channeled walls that provide added strength and help resist crushing under heavier loads. Contoured end panels of these containers create integrated handles for comfortable lifting. These boxes have robust latches that securely attach the lid to the base while the textured finish provides a non-slip grip. These totes feature a tight-fit, drip-protected lid that provides maximum protection against items getting wet. Deep recessed lids of the totes allow for secure stacking to maximize available storage space. Keyholes in the lid provide options for tie-downs to keep totes in place when transporting and storing. The rugged black totes feature an exciting red latch that helps you easily identify where to open the totes. Safely and securely store your rugged items such as tools, camping equipment, job-site materials, and more with the 8-pack of Sterilite Industrial Totes.
